void-system-every-heroine-makes-me-stron:
Severin Morcant Transmigrated and wakes inside a deadly Divine Trial Dungeon, in a world he doesn't recognize, carrying a power its own System cannot explain.
[New Title Acquired.]
[Title: Blessings of the Void]
[New Skill Acquired.]
[Unknown Skill Detected.]
[Unknown Skill: Void System]
Severin Morcant stared at the words floating inside his mind.
An unknown Skill.
“Well, shit.!!”
Then more words appeared.
[Void Devour]
[Void Intimate]
[Void Forge]
[Void Override]
Severin read the names twice.
Devour. Intimate. Forge. Override.
A slow smile pulled at one corner of his mouth,as he understood its function.
Whatever had dragged him into this unfamiliar world clearly had interesting plans for him.
Unfortunately for everyone else, Severin had plans of his own.
He had no interest in becoming the noble hero who saved strangers for free, forgave every enemy, and handed his rewards to people with sad stories. If this world expected that kind of man, it had summoned the wrong bastard.
Monsters could become strength.
Enemies could become resources.
And the women who become his, could give him something no ordinary man could take.…
